text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Lul~ lulu~♪ 
Spring breeze feels so gentle…♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Oh? Up early…

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… these discs contain past Best Escort pairs… 
Maybe grab photo records too…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Miracle-san. 
Early committee work?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Zephyr. 
This is… personal matter.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Personal…? 
Are those… past Droite archives?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Gathering materials for Ruby. 
…Working hard for 'Best Escort.'

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
From dawn to midnight… Even in busy schedule, 
she practices dancing. —Full devotion.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, want to help. 
Hope these help her.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If interested, Zephyr, 
want me to pull some for you too?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No need… 
Leaving it to Yamase winds, so all fine.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sure? If questions or issues pop up, 
let me know anytime.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. But… main concern 
is how hard you push yourself, Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't worry about me. 
Honestly happy just helping.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Look at time… Committee duties call. 
Catch you later.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …………Breeze-like, frustrating. —Never changing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Always puts others first… 
Always reaching out to lend hand.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how brushed off, always prioritizing someone else. 
Taking on heavy burden just to aid others.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Masking pain behind soft breeze… 
saying it's all for 'someone else.')

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(…Will Miracle-san give up own self 
…for 'someone else'?)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Where is 'you'…?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, Zeph-chi~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yo, check this sound! 
Rate it…? Trash…?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well… sounds like raging sandstorm.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Violin is stupid hard! Pivot time~? 
Thought Ojousama'd dig violin vibes though.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Planned to play for Ruby-san?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Gotta be her escort! Max flex mode♡! 
Pivot to next thing! Got cool instrument recs, 
hit me up!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Honest about desires, truly.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If only Miracle-san… had piece of that…

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Want to check committee rental outfits now? 
Bigger lineup this year.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please. 
Deciding rental choice after seeing.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Costumes are cool, 
but event plans need fresh juice too~.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Hm? Someone over there?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …What are you doing, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bam-chan~! Right now, 
Operation Woo Ojousama: Best Escort is live~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Best… what?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Best Escort~ ez dub, ya know? 
Big brain play! Runnin it back!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sent legit formal invite! For real this time! 
My lady gonna fall hard!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Understood… 
Guess I'll watch—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Received your invitation. Have roughly 15 minutes before 
next schedule, but I will listen.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ojousama~~! You came?! So hype~~!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Normally, prior appointment required, 
but schedule opened up today.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ain't that destiny?! 
Alright, let's roll—!
(Poo~~ Poopoopoo~~~~ Poopee~~!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pwaa~~! Well? 
Got all eyes on me☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Think that's whole different kind of stare…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Stand out = total win!
And・next・up~~? Hype da~~nce!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha~, definitely eye-catching…!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Told ya~? Pure Best Escort energy, right?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hold up! Best Escort ain't that easy!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. Aim for 'Most Fun Award' instead?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wha! Can't sweep both? 
Hey, Ojousama, Best Escort is ours if————

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry,
but urgent matters call for my presence. Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? W-wait, wait up, hold on!
Rejected again?! What'd I do wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: MY PRINCESSーーーー!
